sql: WITH FamilyCounts AS (SELECT family, COUNT(*) AS num_listings FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open AND remote_us AND is_canonical_listing GROUP BY family), TotalCount AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_listings FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open AND remote_us AND is_canonical_listing) SELECT fc.family, fc.num_listings, CAST(fc.num_listings AS DOUBLE) / tc.total_listings AS share FROM FamilyCounts fc, TotalCount tc ORDER BY fc.num_listings DESC
